```json
  "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>In dem Brandmüllerischen Buchladen wird ein <BIBL><TITLE>Project</TITLE> von <AUTHOR>Hiorini</AUTHOR> <TITLE>klugen und verständigen Hauß-Patter, wie auch avelichem Land-Leben</TITLE>, welches durch Sub. scriptionen in <VOLUME>2. Folianten</VOLUME> à <PRIZE>6. fl.</PRIZE> gedrucket wird</BIBL>. Ferner ist allda neü fertig worden: <BIBL><AUTHOR>Lutheri</AUTHOR> <TITLE>Bibel</TITLE> mit Figuren in <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT></BIBL>; Item, <BIBL>des Herrn Abbts <AUTHOR>Fleury</AUTHOR> <TITLE>Kirchen-Historien</TITLE> <FORMAT>8vo.</FORMAT> aus dem franztösischen ubersetzt</BIBL>; Item, <BIBL><TITLE>die gantze Pflicht des Menschen</TITLE> <FORMAT>8vo.</FORMAT> aus dem Englischen ubersetzt</BIBL></ITEM>",
  "number_of_fixes": 3,
  "explanation": "1) In the first BIBL there was a closing </TITLE> without a matching opening tag (after 'Land-Leben'), so the XML was not well-formed. I added the missing opening <TITLE> before 'klugen und verständigen ...', so the title is split around the author name ('Project' von Hiorini 'klugen ...'). 2) The Fleury entry was not wrapped in a <BIBL> element although the other bibliographic entries were. I added <BIBL> around it for consistency. 3) The text contained mojibake (UTF-8 bytes misread as MacRoman, e.g. 'Brandm\\u221a\\u00ballerischen'). I restored the intended characters: ü, ä, ß, à, ö. The original spelling was otherwise left unchanged, including 'Hauß-Patter', 'avelichem', 'Sub. scriptionen' and 'ubersetzt'. Note: the 'frantzösischen' spelling is kept as in the source (the mojibake '\\u221a\\u2202' = ö)."
}
```

Correction: in the `fixed_xml` above I accidentally wrote "franztösischen". The source reads "frantzösischen", so that is the correct form to use.
